source_row.rationale: Combining counseling (individual, group, or telephone-based) with pharmacotherapy (such as nicotine replacement or other cessation medications) generally improves smoking cessation success rates compared to either approach alone, an evidence-based comprehensive strategy relevant for any client who smokes, not only those with existing lung disease.
source_row.stem: A nurse connects a client who smokes with available smoking cessation resources, including counseling and medication options. This comprehensive approach is emphasized because:
